plugins.name: inline-images
plugins.description: Shows pictures right in the transcript: under each Read of a picture and under prompts with pasted images (Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm)

plugins.name: time-sense
plugins.description: Gives Claude a sense of time: every prompt carries the current date, time, weekday, time zone and how long ago the previous prompt was

plugins.name: autostart
plugins.description: Runs the AUTOSTART.md of the directory Claude starts in as the session's first prompt, once you have trusted that file with /autostart
